'''Tim Guzman Rescue The Princess''' is a [[Light]] constructed list [[Tim Guzman]] published on [[The Outer Rim (fan site)|The Outer Rim]].<ref name="or">[http://www.geocities.com/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/balancedecks/11lite.html Rescue The Princess], The Outer Rim (Tim Guzman). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20020224070402/http://www.geocities.com:80/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/balancedecks/11lite.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Tim Guzman]]
* '''Published:''' by 12 May 2001 (The Outer Rim)
* '''Published title:''' ''Rescue The Princess''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Special Edition]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Rescue The Princess / Sometimes I Amaze Even Myself|SE-L-rescuetheprincess.gif|label=Rescue The Princess}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PSE RTP Guzman LS 2001 OuterRim.txt |Download]] (omits Wise Advice (Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty): not in GEMP)
* '''Strategy:''' Rescue The Princess

== Introduction ==

Tim Guzman posted this Rescue The Princess list on The Outer Rim as The Information Broker. The published title is Rescue The Princess!.
